spec.name: install-corpus-path
spec.intent: Census @8d0a7283 (design at 8d0a7283; notebook at 8d0a7283 plus the decision note "mav's cell restates its role"); every path is repo-relative on the plan's line. A line number, count or observed behaviour cited here is a measurement at that commit: re-derive it if its path changed since. Add no new test file: a new one must be classified in packages/canon/test/gate-convicts.test.ts, which no unit of this plan owns; extend the test files named in outputs. Realize the command line's no-footguns clause (no flag silently ignored; every error says what went wrong and what to do) for how `cratylus install` chooses its corpus. Two defects at 8d0a7283. (1) `--plugin <pkg>` is accepted and ignored: packages/forge/src/cli/index.ts:307-311 declares it and the action passes it beside corpus: options.defaultCorpus (:365-367); install() in packages/forge/src/cli/commands/install.ts:325-347 takes a cratylus.config.ts in the cwd, else opts.corpus, and only else the named package, so from the cratylus command the flag never acts. Ruled (decision note 'install --plugin is ignored by the cratylus command'): remove --plugin from install and its help; another corpus is installed by naming it in a cratylus.config.ts. Remove the option, the `plugin` field of install's options and the dynamic-import branch it fed (:332-340), and reword the no-corpus refusal (:344-346) and the header comment (:12-16) so neither names --plugin. `cratylus init --plugin` is a different flag and stays. (2) In a directory whose cratylus.config.ts cannot be loaded (the file `cratylus init` writes, before its packages are installed), install ends in an uncaught stack trace (note 'install in a directory with an unresolvable cratylus.config.ts prints a stack trace'): loadConfig (:326) throws MissingPackageError, ConfigLoadError or ConfigShapeError (packages/forge/src/config/loader.ts), each already carrying a one-line message saying what is wrong and what to do, and runInstall (:259-268) rethrows anything that is not a Refusal. Make install end such a run with that one line as `cratylus install: <message>`, exit 1, nothing written. packages/cli/README.md: drop the install --plugin row (:389) and the sentences about it (:37-39), and say what install does where the cwd's config cannot be loaded. Add a patch changeset for @cratylus/forge and cratylus.
accept: with packages/cli and the packages it depends on built, `node packages/cli/dist/cratylus.js install --help` lists no `--plugin`, and `node packages/cli/dist/cratylus.js install --harness claude --plugin x --all --dry-run` (HOME a temp dir holding .claude) exits 1 with one stderr line naming --plugin as an option install does not take (at 8d0a7283 the flag is accepted)

in a temp directory holding only the cratylus.config.ts that `cratylus init` writes (no node_modules), with HOME a temp dir holding .claude, `node <repo>/packages/cli/dist/cratylus.js install --harness claude --all --dry-run` exits 1, prints nothing on stdout and exactly one stderr line, which starts `cratylus install: ` and names the package to install; no stderr line starts with spaces and `at ` (at 8d0a7283 it ends in a stack trace)
`git grep -n -e '--plugin' -- packages/forge/src/cli/commands/install.ts` prints nothing, and every line `git grep -n -e '--plugin' -- packages/cli/README.md` prints lies in the `cratylus init` entry
in packages/cli, `pnpm exec vitest run test/command-tree.test.ts` exits 0; in packages/forge, `pnpm exec vitest run test/cli/install.test.ts` exits 0
